title: ActionHook Base Payload
description: Common fields present in every actionHook callback payload. All verb-specific callback schemas extend this base.

from.description: Caller phone number or SIP URI.

to.description: Called phone number or SIP URI.

sip_reason.description: SIP reason phrase from the SIP status line (e.g. 'OK', 'Busy Here'). Not the RFC 3326 Reason header - see sip_reason_header.

sip_reason_header.description: RFC 3326 Reason header of the SIP message that caused this status change (e.g. 'Q.850;cause=18'), if it carried one; absent otherwise. Carriers fronting ISDN/E1 PRI trunks put the authoritative disconnect cause here rather than in the status line, and the same SIP status can carry different causes - a 503 may be cause=38 (network out of order) or cause=41 (temporary failure) - so the status code alone cannot classify the outcome. Present on whichever event observed it: a final failure response, a BYE, or a CANCEL. Two caveats: the header is re-serialized in transit, which normalizes the optional whitespace RFC 3326 allows around ';' (a carrier's 'Q.850 ;cause=18' arrives as 'Q.850;cause=18'), so parse tolerantly rather than string-matching; and a message may carry more than one Reason header, in which case they arrive comma-separated - split on commas outside quotes, since a text="..." value may contain one.

trace_id.description: Distributed tracing identifier for correlating logs across jambonz components.

originating_sip_ip.description: IP address of the originating SIP trunk.

originating_sip_trunk_name.description: Name of the originating SIP trunk as configured in jambonz.

api_base_url.description: jambonz REST API base URL. Use this for mid-call control via the REST API.
